messages:
Lina Patel: FYI intake for Marlin-13B bring-up. Goal: hosted + dedicated canary next week. Need quant results, eval gating, canary config, and fallback route. Who can pick tasks?
Josh Kim: I can run quant experiments (INT8 / INT4) and perf profiles. targeting initial perf baselines today. what's our latency SLO for hosted?
Lina Patel: p95 gen token latency target 150ms for hosted default; dedicated pools can be higher (200ms) but want predictable throughput.
Maya Rivera: I'll run eval suites — summarization ROUGE / factuality checks / instruction-following. quick heads up: early INT4 runs show ~3% ROUGE-L drop on long docs, need deeper diffs.
Josh Kim: noted. I'll run INT8+4 with KV cache and calibration set. also will collect token-cost delta.
Anita Gomez: Canary plan proposal: hosted canary = 1% traffic -> 5% -> 20% over 3 days with automated checks; dedicated canary = enable on one reserved pool at 0.5 qps then scale. rollback triggers: quality delta >1.5% ROUGE-L, hallucination metric up, p95 >200ms, error rate >0.5%.
Lina Patel: agree on gating. add synthetic adversarial prompt set mirror for first 24h. also require tracing hooks enabled + per-request prompt/response sampling to S3 for first 72h.
Josh Kim: quick config stub for canary policy:
```yaml
canary:
  hosted:
    start_pct: 1
    steps: [1,5,20]
    metrics:
      - name: rouge_l_delta
        threshold: -1.5
      - name: p95_latency_ms
        threshold: 200
  dedicated:
    start_pool: pool-marlin-a
    start_qps: 0.5
    monitor_window: 24h
```
Anita Gomez: add fallback routing: primary -> marlin-13b, fallback -> raven-7b-int8 (fast variant). fallback triggers same as rollback. ensure cached prefixes compatible across variants.
Maya Rivera: Eval run schedule: batch evals 1) instr-follow (2k prompts), 2) summarization long-form (500 examples), 3) factuality sieve (1k adversarial). sending results by EOD tomorrow.
deploy-bot: pipeline queued: canary-deploy-marlin-13b (hosted) — job id cd-4821. smoke tests starting.
deploy-bot: smoke tests: tokenization / kv-cache / streaming smoke passed. perf smoke running.
Josh Kim: saw perf smoke: initial p95 = 138ms INT8; INT4 p95 = 165ms but quality dip is the concern. I'll share calibration/quant settings.
Lina Patel: plan for next steps: 1) Josh finish quant + perf matrix, 2) Maya complete evals and flag failing cases, 3) Anita finalize canary YAML and rollout playbook, 4) run hosted 1% canary with tracing + mirror, watch 24h, then decide. tagging follow-ups: @Josh Kim @Maya Rivera @Anita Gomez. :white_check_mark:
